package.name: rebel_medicine_grasp_description
package.description: Dual-arm igus ReBeL rig for medicine grasp (shelf picking of medical cartons): the stand/lift/sliders/arms of rebel_dual_arm_stand_description with the v5 suction tool on arm_left and the SMC LEHF20K2-48 gripper on arm_right (no knife / XEG-32 / cutting tooling). URDF/xacro + tool meshes. Mock hardware / Isaac-topic only; no real-hardware path. Companion package: rebel_medicine_grasp_moveit_config.
